verdict.rationale: Segment's documented Public API supports CRUD on Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans. It ships with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, token auth, rate-limit, pagination and versioning docs, and SDKs, so an agent can programmatically create sources and destinations. Wiring a source to a destination is only implied by destination CRUD, and nothing in the pack shows delivery or event-delivery inspection or an MCP server. Missing for 10: documented delivery/event-delivery inspection endpoints, explicit evidence of wiring sources to destinations, an official MCP server or other agent-specific tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: You can use the API to perform CRUD (create, read, update, and delete) operations at no extra charge. This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
